ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Abans Financial Services Limited (AFSL) has formally allotted 377,831 new equity shares as part of its ESOP Scheme 2023, a common practice for employee compensation and retention. This action increases the company's issued and paid-up equity capital to Rs. 10,24,35,180, corresponding to 51,217,590 total shares outstanding. While this results in a minor dilution of existing shareholder ownership, the disclosure itself is routine under SEBI regulations and does not indicate any immediate red flags.
